stories.headline: Carborundum Universal raised FY27 Ceramics guidance to 23-25%, from 15-15.5% earlier
stories.instagram_caption:
Carborundum Universal raised its FY27 Ceramics segment growth guidance to 23-25%, up from the 15-15.5% guided earlier.
Consolidated FY27 guidance was also raised, to 15% from the prior 11-12% (ex-closures).
Q1 consolidated sales grew 16.9% YoY; standalone sales grew 21.2% YoY, with margins holding despite cost inflation.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: "CARBORUNDUM UNIVERSAL - FY27 GUIDANCE RAISED"]
VO: Carborundum Universal just raised its own full-year guidance.
[ON-SCREEN: "Ceramics: 15-15.5% -> 23-25%"]
VO: The Ceramics segment's growth target moved from 15-15.5 percent up to a new range of 23 to 25 percent.
[ON-SCREEN: "Consolidated: 11-12% -> 15%"]
VO: Consolidated FY27 growth guidance was also raised, from 11-12 percent to 15 percent.
[ON-SCREEN: "Q1: Consolidated sales +16.9% YoY"]
VO: This follows a Q1 where consolidated sales grew 16.9 percent year-on-year, and standalone sales grew 21.2 percent, with margins holding up despite cost inflation.
[ON-SCREEN: "Factual summary of public disclosures. Not investment advice."]
VO: Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: HGS guided margin improvement; Q1 EBITDA margin instead fell to 9.7% from 15.7%
stories.instagram_caption:
Hinduja Global Solutions had guided toward margin improvement heading into Q1.
Instead, EBITDA margin compressed to 9.7%, down from 15.7% previously.
Revenue also declined 3.2% sequentially to Rs 1,050.4 crores, on planned legacy contract runoff and one-time investment costs.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: "HGS - Q1 FY27"]
VO: Hinduja Global Solutions had guided toward margin improvement this quarter.
[ON-SCREEN: "EBITDA margin: 15.7% -> 9.7%"]
VO: Instead, EBITDA margin compressed to 9.7 percent, down from 15.7 percent.
[ON-SCREEN: "Revenue: -3.2% QoQ, Rs1,050.4cr"]
VO: Revenue also declined 3.2 percent sequentially to Rs 1,050.4 crores, which management attributed to planned legacy contract runoff and one-time investment costs.
[ON-SCREEN: "19 new logos ramping; Project Ganga launched June 2026"]
VO: Management said it expects margin recovery as these investments commercialize and new client logos ramp up.
[ON-SCREEN: "Factual summary of public disclosures. Not investment advice."]
VO: Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Cello World withdrew its earlier 10-12% FY27 growth commitment, gave no new guidance
stories.instagram_caption:
Cello World had earlier committed to 10-12% FY27 growth.
On this call, management withdrew that commitment and declined to provide new FY27 guidance, citing a tough environment.
Q1 revenue was Rs 526.7 crores with a 22.2% EBITDA margin; steel bottle SKUs are down to 20-25 from 150 previously, on in-house manufacturing ramp delays.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: "CELLO WORLD - GUIDANCE WITHDRAWN"]
VO: Cello World had earlier committed to 10 to 12 percent FY27 growth.
[ON-SCREEN: "10-12% commitment -> withdrawn"]
VO: On this call, management withdrew that commitment and did not replace it with new FY27 guidance, citing a tough environment.
[ON-SCREEN: "Steel bottles: 150 SKUs -> 20-25 SKUs"]
VO: One driver: steel bottle SKUs are down to just 20 to 25, from 150 previously, due to delays ramping up in-house manufacturing.
[ON-SCREEN: "Q1: Revenue Rs526.7cr, EBITDA margin 22.2%"]
VO: Q1 revenue came in at Rs 526.7 crores with a 22.2 percent EBITDA margin, and writing instruments grew 52 percent year-on-year.
[ON-SCREEN: "Factual summary of public disclosures. Not investment advice."]
VO: Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Advit Jewels declined to give FY27-28 guidance even after direct prompts on the call
stories.instagram_caption:
Advit Jewels (RAMBHAJO) was asked directly for FY27-FY28 guidance on this call.
Management declined, pointing instead to projections on the company website.
Q1 revenue grew 37% YoY to Rs 35.4 crores; EBITDA margin expanded to 33.12%, from 29.04% in Q4.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: "ADVIT JEWELS (RAMBHAJO)"]
VO: Advit Jewels was directly asked for FY27 and FY28 guidance on its earnings call.
[ON-SCREEN: "Direct question -> declined to guide"]
VO: Management declined to give a number, pointing instead to projections already posted on the company website.
[ON-SCREEN: "Q1: Revenue Rs35.4cr, +37% YoY"]
VO: This comes after a Q1 where revenue grew 37 percent year-on-year to Rs 35.4 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded to 33.12 percent, from 29.04 percent in the fourth quarter.
[ON-SCREEN: "3 new stores planned for FY27"]
VO: The company also outlined plans for a flagship store by November and three new stores through FY27.
[ON-SCREEN: "Factual summary of public disclosures. Not investment advice."]
VO: Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.

stories.headline: Info Edge's Q1 billings grew 14%, ahead of its own guided 10-11% range
stories.instagram_caption:
Info Edge (Naukri) had guided Q1 billings growth of 10-11%.
Actual billings growth came in at 14%, with about a third of recruitment growth attributed to AI-Rex and Talent Pulse.
99acres grew 17% and neared profitability ahead of its FY27 target; jobseeker growth accelerated to 35%.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: "INFO EDGE (NAUKRI) - Q1 FY27"]
VO: Info Edge had guided Q1 billings growth of 10 to 11 percent.
[ON-SCREEN: "Billings growth: 14% vs 10-11% guided"]
VO: Actual billings growth came in at 14 percent, ahead of that range.
[ON-SCREEN: "99acres: +17%, near profitability"]
VO: 99acres grew 17 percent and moved closer to profitability, ahead of its FY27 target.
[ON-SCREEN: "Jobseeker growth: 35%"]
VO: Jobseeker growth accelerated to 35 percent, with paid conversion at 2.6 percent.
[ON-SCREEN: "Factual summary of public disclosures. Not investment advice."]
